style: Vertical background plate for a cartoon animation short, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no logos. Stylized 3D cartoon render, clean rounded shapes, thin dark outlines, rich detail, saturated colors, cinematic lighting, soft depth of field, like a modern animated explainer short.

plates.prompt: A brand-new 1940s US Army air base in the New Mexico desert at dusk: a big arched corrugated metal hangar on fire with tall cartoon flames on its roof, a control tower, an American flag on a pole, silver fuel tanks, tarmac in the foreground, smoke columns, glowing embers, dramatic red-orange and purple sky.

New Mexico desert at dusk: a huge dark cave mouth in layered red rock cliffs, a giant ribbon of thousands of tiny black bats streaming out of the cave into a purple and orange sunset sky, a 1940s rounded car parked on a dirt road in the foreground, cacti and rocks.

View from the driver's seat inside a 1940s car at dusk: wooden dashboard with a glowing round radio dial, a big thin steering wheel, chrome knobs, the windshield shows a straight desert highway with telegraph poles, mesas and a setting sun.

Inside a 1940s car at dusk, view across the empty front bench seat toward the driver side window, red leather seat, chrome door handle, warm sunset light streaming in, desert landscape blurred outside the window.

A stately 1940s presidential office seen from in front of the desk: tall windows with heavy blue curtains, an American flag on a brass pole, bookshelves, a dark wooden desk across the bottom of the picture with a green banker's lamp and a fountain pen, daylight.
Top-down close view of a polished dark wooden desk: a fountain pen, an ink pot, a brass desk lamp casting warm light, a rubber stamp, a blank cream paper in the middle, leather desk pad.

A cozy 1940s American dentist's office: green dental chair with a round lamp on an arm, white cabinets with glass jars and tools, framed diploma on a mint green wall, window with warm afternoon sunlight, wooden floor, potted plants.

A 1940s US Army laboratory: a long wooden workbench in the foreground, empty in the middle, test tubes, brass instruments, a chalkboard with diagrams, olive green walls, hanging industrial lamps, a big white vintage refrigerator on the right.
Front view into an open vintage 1940s refrigerator, three shelves each holding white ice cube trays, frost on the walls, cold blue light glowing from inside, the open door on the left.

A shiny brand-new 1940s US Army air base in the New Mexico desert at noon: an arched corrugated metal hangar, a control tower, an American flag, wide empty tarmac in the foreground, heat shimmer, bright blue sky with small clouds, mesas in the distance.

A 1940s olive green military staff car parked on the tarmac in front of a burning arched metal hangar at a desert air base at dusk, flames on the hangar roof, smoke, orange glow, empty space in front of the car.

Cross-section cutaway view of a small wooden house at night: the attic under a pointed roof with wooden beams, a cozy pitch-dark corner under the eaves on the right, warm lit windows in the floor below, starry night sky with a moon, dark blue tones.

A cozy bedroom at night: a bed with a blue blanket and a dark shadowy gap under the bed, an open cardboard box on the floor in front, a bedside lamp glowing warm, a window with the moon, dark blue tones with warm lamp light.
Close-up of a 1940s black typewriter on a wooden army office desk, round keys, a blank sheet of paper in the roller, warm golden evening light from a window.

A small 1940s US Army office at golden hour seen from in front of a desk: a window behind showing grey smoke rising outside, olive filing cabinets, a coat rack, a wall clock, an empty wooden chair behind the desk, the desk edge across the bottom.
A 1940s army map room wall: a big empty cork board on dark wood paneling, a green desk lamp, pins and string on the side, warm light, dark wooden floor at the bottom.
